2609.08402.title: Towards Embodied Air-Ground Cooperative Object Search: Benchmark, Dataset and Agentic Method
2609.08402.paper_summary: Air-Ground Object Search (AGOS) in urban environments is a challenging embodied task, which requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to jointly search for and verify a specified target vehicle from multi-view visual references. To study this underexplored problem, we introduce AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification through UAV-UGV cooperation. We further provide AGOS-Dataset as the companion resource of exemplary trajectories constructed by an automatic pipeline. It consists of 7.7k episodes for searching objects of diverse categories and attributes, spanning three difficulty levels. To address the AGOS task, we propose AGOS-Agent, a training-free and tool-augmented approach. The agentic method relieves VLMs from complex and dynamic coordination via a deliberate search-handoff-verify cooperation protocol, only demanding VLMs for scene understanding and decision-making. Extensive experiments on nine VLMs show that AGOS-Agent improves overall success rate for eight of the nine evaluated backbones while reducing decision steps for all nine. On the hard split, the SR and SPL of Gemini-3.6-Flash increase from 8.6% to 55.7% and from 7.6% to 44.0%, respectively.
2609.08402.paper_summary_zh: 城市環境中的空地物體搜索（AGOS）是一項具有挑戰性的具身任務，要求無人機（UAV）和無人地面車輛（UGV）共同搜索並驗證指定的目標車輛，並從多視角視覺參考中進行確認。為了研究這一未被充分探索的問題，我們引入了AGOS-Bench，這是首個專門的基準，用於評估通用視覺-語言模型（VLMs）是否能通過UAV-UGV合作整合空中發現和地面驗證。我們進一步提供AGOS-Dataset，作為由自動化流程構建的示例軌跡的伴隨資源。它包含7.7k集集數，用於搜索多樣類別和屬性的物體，涵蓋三個難度級別。為了解決AGOS任務，我們提出了AGOS-Agent，一種無需訓練且增強工具的方法。這種代理方法通過一個精心設計的搜索-交接-驗證合作協議，減輕了VLMs在複雜和動態協調中的負擔，只要求VLMs進行場景理解和決策。對九個VLMs的廣泛實驗顯示，AGOS-Agent提高了九個評估基礎中的八個的整體成功率，同時減少了所有九個的決策步驟。在困難的分割中，Gemini-3.6-Flash的SR和SPL分別從8.6%提高到55.7%和從7.6%提高到44.0%。
